name: dspy
description: Builds and optimizes language model programs with DSPy (Stanford NLP), using Signatures, modules (Predict, ChainOfThought, ReAct, ProgramOfThought) and optimizers (BootstrapFewShot, MIPRO, BootstrapFinetune). Use when replacing hand-written prompts with declarative signatures, when automatically tuning prompts against training data and a metric, when building multi-stage RAG pipelines or ReAct agents, when building classifiers or structured-output programs, or when saving and evaluating optimize
author: KalarisLabs
